preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.
The number of piranhas in each test case is between 2 and 300,000.
The size of each piranha is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: Sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of piranhas across all test cases is at most 300,000.

postconditions.expression: -1 if there is no dominant piranha, otherwise 1 <= index <= n
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no dominant piranha, or the index of any dominant piranha otherwise.
